en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographic views of the same large, plain three‑story house or manor. The upper image shows the front façade along a road, lined with leafless trees and shrubs and a gate in the foreground. The lower image shows the garden side of the building with trimmed topiary bushes and more bare trees. At the bottom, there is a red printed caption identifying the place.
